baseline.note: Baseline from the full translation audit. Counts must be regenerated after anchor, fenced-content, Markdown-invariant, and terminology repairs before this ledger can be marked complete.

scope.scan_unit: Every Han-character occurrence outside approved fenced blocks and inline-code spans
scope.acceptance: Every current residual occurrence must match exactly one reviewed ledger entry or be classified by a deterministic rule with an auditable reason. Zero unexplained_prose and zero unresolved_anchor entries are permitted at final acceptance.

protected_literal.description: Chinese text whose exact value is operationally protected, such as an input trigger, enumerated output value, field value, identifier-like literal, or user-facing literal consumed by a workflow.

operational_chinese_output.description: Chinese text intentionally emitted by a workflow because the downstream fiction artifact, report, prompt, or user-visible output is defined to be Chinese.

proper_name_or_title.description: A proper name, work title, platform/product name, character name, or culturally specific label intentionally retained in Chinese.

intentional_bilingual_example.description: Chinese retained beside or within an English explanation to demonstrate source-language wording, usage, dialogue, terminology, or a translation distinction.

unresolved_anchor.description: Chinese retained only because a Markdown fragment or heading reference was not localized correctly.

unexplained_prose.description: Residual Chinese prose without a documented functional, linguistic, naming, or operational reason to remain in an English translation.

entry_schema.line_semantics: Line number in the current translated file at the source commit recorded by the future manifest/audit run. Regenerate line numbers after content changes rather than treating them as permanent identifiers.
entry_schema.matching_semantics: Entries must identify the path and exact literal. expected_count prevents an approved literal from silently multiplying. When the same literal has different meanings in one file, create separate entries with line-specific reasons.

deterministic_rules.scope: Authoritative source fenced blocks already governed by TRANSLATION_WORKFLOW.md
deterministic_rules.reason: Fenced-content policy already requires byte-identical preservation and separately marks any English companion. The residual-language scan should report these counts separately, not duplicate every fenced occurrence in this ledger.

deterministic_rules.scope: Technical inline-code literals already verified by the translation invariant validator
deterministic_rules.reason: Inline-code preservation is enforced by the Markdown/literal validator. Residual-language reporting should count these separately from prose residue.
